objective.statement: Add a navbar positioned at the top of the app with Home, About and Contact links; About and Contact are skeleton views only and Home links back to HomeView.

complexity.rationale: New shared component, two new views and two new routes across the app shell and router, delivered as three small TDD increments; no contracts, state or approval-boundary work.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A navbar is rendered at the top of the app, above the routed view content.
The navbar has Home, About and Contact links.
The Home link navigates to the route that renders HomeView.
About and Contact each have a skeleton view (heading only) reachable from their navbar link.

in.statement: New Navbar component, AboutView and ContactView skeletons, /about and /contact routes, and rendering the navbar in the App shell.

out.statement: Real About/Contact content, forms, mobile hamburger menu, branding/logo, and changes to HomeView content.

observations.statement: Routes are /, /about and /contact; Home is the existing index route.
No new dependency: react-router-dom NavLink and existing Tailwind tokens are used.

capabilityOwners.rationale: Active-link state comes from the router's NavLink; no component state.

component.rationale: Navbar, views and App shell composition are rendered component behaviour.

integration.rationale: No cross-module data flow; npm run test is run as regression.

e2e.rationale: Skeleton navigation only; routing is covered by component tests with a memory router.

increments.behavior: Navbar renders Home, About and Contact links to /, /about and /contact.
AboutView and ContactView skeletons render a heading.
App shell renders the navbar above the outlet and the router serves the new views.

tests.description: Navbar shows Home, About, Contact links with the expected hrefs.
App renders the navbar before the routed content, and the router navigates to About/Contact/Home views.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: No navbar in App; no /about or /contact routes.
expectedRedEvidence.observedFailure: 5 App tests failed: routes export undefined (createMemoryRouter TypeError)

verification.requirement: npm test, npm run lint and npm run build pass.
verification.command: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
verification.result: unit 4/4, component 19/19 (7 files), lint clean, build ok
